title: NexZen Restro
tagline: Unified Cloud Platform for Restaurant Operations
impact: Successfully processed 50,000+ orders while maintaining a 99.9% uptime architecture. The platform reduced manual administrative operations by 70% and empowered owners with real-time, data-driven business analytics.
description:
Overview & Objective: Modern restaurants often rely on fragmented systems, causing operational inefficiencies. NexZen Restro is a unified, production-grade cloud platform that centralizes POS, kitchen workflows, inventory, payroll, and analytics into a single dashboard.

Core Features:
- Centralized POS: Fast, touchscreen-optimized billing capable of handling split checks and multi-payment methods.
- Smart Inventory: Automated, real-time stock depletion with low-stock alerts.
- Kitchen Display System (KDS): Direct order routing from POS to kitchen, eliminating paper tickets.
- Staff Management: Integrated time-tracking, scheduling, and automated payroll.
techStackStr: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS

title: AI Job Hunter
impact: Successfully automated and dispatched 20+ high-quality applications. The platform drastically reduced the manual overhead of international job hunting by unifying the search, translation, and application processes into one seamless workflow.
description:
Overview & Objective: Navigating the European job market involves language barriers and repetitive application processes. AI Job Hunter acts as an automated recruitment assistant, streamlining job discovery, localization, and application submission for European opportunities.

Core Features:
- Multi-Country Job Crawling: Aggregates roles across various European job boards.
- AI Cover Letter Generation: Dynamically crafts context-aware cover letters tailored to specific job descriptions.
- Translation & Normalization workflows: Normalizes foreign salary ranges into standard currencies and translates job requirements.
- Pipeline Tracking: A Kanban-style dashboard for tracking application statuses.
techStackStr: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js runtime, Route Handlers, JSON CMS, AI APIs

title: Dynamic Portfolio CMS
impact: Enabled instant content updates and fast deployments while completely removing external database dependencies. This resulted in a highly cost-effective, simple maintenance workflow tailored specifically for developer portfolios.
description:
Overview & Objective: Maintaining a developer portfolio often requires managing a database or making cumbersome source-code edits. This project is a lightweight, zero-database JSON-driven CMS built to allow instant content updates without backend overhead.

Core Features:
- Admin Dashboard: A secure UI for managing projects, skills, experience, and social links.
- Zero-Database Architecture: Utilizes JSON storage and Next.js Route Handlers for lightning-fast reads and writes.
- Resume Integration: Direct upload and management of CV files.
techStackStr: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Route Handlers, JSON storage

title: Ambikeshori Travels
impact: Eliminated developer intervention for daily business operations. The SEO-focused architecture improved search visibility, while the independent package management system streamlined the client's operational workflow.
description:
Overview & Objective: Launched in February 2026, this commercial travel management platform was built to free the client from relying on developers for minor content updates. It features a fully decoupled architecture with a bespoke MERN-stack CMS.

Core Features:
- Independent MERN-Stack CMS: Allows travel staff to add/edit destinations, packages, and operational workflows autonomously.
- Streamlined Inquiry Workflow: Centralized dashboard for tracking and responding to customer booking requests.
- Decoupled Frontend: A blazing-fast Next.js frontend optimized for SEO and image-heavy travel content.
techStackStr: MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js, Next.js frontend integration

title: LandBDevs
impact: Dramatically improved the client's digital brand presence, turning a traditional consultancy into a modern online business capable of capturing organic leads for both engineering projects and property sales.
description:
Overview & Objective: LandBDevs required a digital portal that effectively communicated their civil engineering expertise while simultaneously functioning as a searchable real-estate and property listing platform.

Core Features:
- Business Service Showcase: Professional, modern landing pages detailing engineering consultancy services.
- Property Discovery: A highly searchable, filterable real estate listing interface.
- Lead Generation Support: Integrated contact and inquiry forms routed directly to the firm.

title: Best Mid-West Tours & Travels
impact: Greatly improved regional tourism visibility for the client, leveraging an inquiry-driven user experience to convert website traffic into actionable business leads.
description:
Overview & Objective: Best Mid-West Tours & Travels needed a modern commercial tourism website to promote regional travel packages and capture booking inquiries effectively across all devices.

Core Features:
- Mobile-First Booking Experience: Responsive design ensuring frictionless navigation and inquiry submission on smartphones.
- Travel Package Promotion: Visually engaging destination showcases with clear calls-to-action.
- Clean, Conversion-Focused UX: Intuitive interface design intended to guide users from discovery to inquiry.

title: TripNest
impact: Delivered a highly scalable, SaaS-ready architecture capable of supporting thousands of concurrent trip generations. The AI-generated travel plans significantly reduced user research time and improved the overall travel planning experience.
description:
Overview & Objective: Planning comprehensive travel itineraries is traditionally time-consuming and fragmented across multiple booking sites. TripNest is an AI-powered travel planning and booking platform designed to generate personalized travel experiences dynamically based on user budget, interests, and duration.

Core Features:
- AI Itinerary Engine: Generates day-by-day, minute-by-minute travel plans using AI workflows.
- Destination Discovery: Intelligent recommendations matching user preferences with global locations.
- Dynamic Budgeting: Real-time cost estimations integrated into the itinerary generation.
techStackStr: Next.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, AI-assisted workflows

title: Japanese Learning Platform
impact: Delivered an exam-focused learning experience that actively improves vocabulary retention over standard textbook studying through immediate, interactive feedback and performance tracking.
description:
Overview & Objective: Preparing for the JFT-Basic and JLPT N5 exams requires intense vocabulary retention and repetitive practice. This dedicated language learning application offers interactive tools to improve exam readiness.

Core Features:
- Interactive Quiz Engine: Simulates real JLPT testing formats and timed environments.
- Flashcard System: Spaced-repetition-inspired flashcards for Hiragana, Katakana, and basic Kanji.
- Progress Tracking: Visual dashboards mapping user readiness against exam requirements.
techStackStr: React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Quiz Engine

title: NEA Level 5 Quiz App
tagline: Nepal Electricity Authority Exam Preparation Platform
impact: Provided a structured exam preparation pipeline that leverages performance analytics to help candidates optimize their study time, significantly modernizing traditional Nepalese civil service exam prep.
description:
Overview & Objective: Candidates preparing for the highly competitive Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA) Level 5 exams lack localized, digital practice environments. This app serves as a data-driven competitive exam preparation platform.

Core Features:
- Categorized Question Banks: Subject-specific modules tailored strictly to the NEA syllabus.
- Timed Quiz Engine: Replicates the pressure and timing constraints of the actual public service exam.
- Score Analytics: Detailed breakdowns of past performance and areas requiring improvement.
techStackStr: React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Quiz Engine

title: Custom WordPress News Portal
impact: Delivered a highly structured category presentation that improved editorial user experience (UX) and maximized reader retention through better content discoverability and accessible design.
description:
Overview & Objective: Digital news portals often suffer from cluttered interfaces that hinder content discoverability. This project focused entirely on interface engineering and visual layout architecture using WordPress and Elementor, rather than backend theme or plugin development.

Core Features:
- Homepage Information Architecture: Strategic placement of breaking news, featured stories, and trending topics.
- Responsive News Blocks: Elementor-driven grid systems that adapt perfectly to mobile and tablet screens.
- Category Layout Systems: Distinct visual identities for different news categories (e.g., Politics, Sports, Tech).

title: Advanced E-Learning Platform
impact: Created a scalable educational architecture supporting complex, secure learning workflows. The built-in progress analytics allow instructors to monitor student engagement and intervene when performance drops.
description:
Overview & Objective: Educational institutions need robust, secure systems to manage digital learning. This production-ready Learning Management System (LMS) provides a scalable architecture for modern education, handling everything from course delivery to administrative reporting.

Core Features:
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Distinct, secure interfaces for administrators, instructors, and students.
- Course Management: Intuitive builder for uploading video lectures, documents, and interactive modules.
- Assessment Workflows: Integrated quiz systems and secure assignment submission portals.
